title: Looks nice, cannot confirm oekotex or other safety testing
text: Looks nice, cannot confirm oekotex or other safety testing. Aesthetically this blanket seemed fine. I cannot honestly comment on the drape or softness of it as I didn’t end up using it. I purchased thinking it was safety certified to be free of harmful chemicals and materials but I couldn’t confirm that after purchase. My mistake I suppose, but the review still stands because if that kind of thing is important to you, better to choose something else.
